images.filename: Avenue of the Stars 星光大道 (5283611559).jpg
images.caption:
Avenue of the Stars, on the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront right across from the Hong Kong Island skyline, honors the movie stars who contributed to the rise of Hong Kong pop culture from the 1960s on. Just as South Korean soap operas and K-pop send young people crazy throughout East Asia and beyond today, Hong Kong pop culture, exemplified by action movies and Cantopop, used to do the same in the 1970s and the 1980s.

This is a statue by Cao Chong-en of the late Bruce Lee (Li Xiaolong, 李小龍), one of the early and best-known actors from Hong Kong. Although born in San Francisco, his parents had hailed from Hong Kong and he was indeed raised here before returning to the US in adulthood.
images.alt:
